kalamType: "Salam"

---

Kon beemar ye zanjeeron may jakrra aaya
Towq o zanjeer ko Sajjad pe rona aaya

1
Shah ne khaich to li seenay se Akbar ke sina
Sath lipta hua barche ke kaleja aaya

2
Khoon may doobi hui Akbar ki jawani dekhi
Haey aaya bhi to kab qasid-e-Sughra aaya

3
Rah takti rahi bachay ki jigar tham ke maa
Khoon may dooba hua besheer ka kurta aaya

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/kaun-beemar-ye-zanjeeron-mein-jakra-hai.md')
_, header, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert roman == original
assert [len(s.splitlines()) for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [2, 3, 3, 3]
assert [s.splitlines()[0] for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')[1:]] == list('۱۲۳')
print('Roman text preserved; opening and three numbered stanzas align.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all eight verses in Urdu script in the [selected lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/dabb019b4b4543d5a78e85fa3886fb53/src/data/lyrics/kaun-beemar-ye-zanjeeron-mein-jakra-hai.md). Verified that `romanLyrics` preserves the original Roman wording and that the opening and three numbered stanzas align in both versions.

Set the direction to `rtl`, added the Roman alternate title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. I read the ambiguous forms `sina` as `سناں` and `besheer` as `بے شیر`.
